title: Analytics card
description: A white analytics card rises, seven soft columns grow from dots while the total counts up, then the best column glows and the result lands. 3 s, silent, 16:9.

slots.name: labels
slots.note: Seven short column labels, comma separated.

slots.name: values
slots.note: Seven real numbers, comma separated, in the same order; the total and the sentence are computed from them.

slots.name: delta
slots.note: The change shown in the badge, e.g. 12.4%.

slots.name: accent
slots.note: The glow colour; warm tones read best on white.

beats.say: The card rises and the columns grow.
beats.visual: A white card rises; seven columns grow from dots to their values as the total counts up.

beats.say: The best day glows and the result lands.
beats.visual: The highlighted column warms to the accent and glows; the result sentence lands.
